instruction:
Use the ANSYS Mechanical APDL GUI to complete the following analysis:

Physical problem: rectangular plate with a central circular hole under uniaxial tension.

Model parameters:
- Plate 100 mm x 200 mm, thickness 1 mm
- Center hole diameter 10 mm
- Material: linear elastic steel, E = 210000 MPa, nu = 0.3
- Element: PLANE183, Plane Stress with thickness option
- Mesh: local refinement to 1 mm around the hole, global size 5 mm

Boundary conditions and load:
- Left and right edges: uniform tension equivalent to nominal stress 10 MPa
- Top and bottom edges: constraints to prevent rigid body motion

Analysis type: static analysis

Save requirements:
- Database file: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\apdl_hole_plate.db
- Result file (.rst) must exist in the working directory
